LESSON: TIME

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.4: Time
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time, part of Measurement in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we raise flag on Monday’s and Friday’s only?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
